greeting.note: {hello} is 'Good morning'/'Good afternoon'/'Good evening'. {who} is ', Storm' (comma included) or empty. Every variant must still read right when {who} is empty. Use {hello} in at least 10 variants.

goodbye.orig: See you later! I'll keep an eye on things.

daysUntil.note: {count} like '41 days' or '1 day'; {thing} like 'christmas'; {when} like 'Friday, December 25'

romanRange.orig: Roman numerals only go from 1 to 3,999.

randomNumber.note: {low}..{high} is the range they asked for

timerSet.note: {label} is usually 'Timer' or a name like 'Pizza'; {duration} like '5 minutes'

timerNoAlerts.orig: Notifications are off, so keep Ace open to see it finish.

alarm.orig: Apps can't set iPad Clock alarms, but I can set a timer or a reminder that rings. Try "remind me at 7am to get up".
alarm.note: Keep both facts: apps can't set Clock alarms; a timer or a reminder works. Keep an example command in quotes in most variants.

recipeNotFound.orig: I couldn't find a recipe for {dish}. Try another name, like "pancakes" or "chicken curry".

weatherAskCity.orig: Which city should I check? Say "weather in" and your city, and I'll remember it.

weatherFail.orig: I couldn't get the weather for {city} right now.

weatherToday.note: {rain} is ', 40% chance of rain' (comma included) or empty

batteryUnknown.orig: I can't read the battery right now.

batteryCharging.orig: Your battery is at {pct}% and charging.

batteryFull.orig: Your battery is at {pct}% and full.

batteryLow.orig: Your battery is at {pct}%. Time to plug in soon.

storageUnknown.orig: I can't read storage right now.

storage.orig: You have {free} free out of {total} ({pct}% free).

storageLow.orig: That's getting low. Offloading unused apps in Settings > General > iPad Storage helps.
storageLow.note: Keep the Settings > General > iPad Storage path.

memoryUsage.orig: Your iPad has {ram} of RAM. I'm using {app}, and about {free} more is free for me. iPadOS doesn't let apps see how much other apps use.

offline.orig: You're offline right now. I can still answer from my answer bank.

noPhoto.orig: Send me a picture with the photo or camera button first, then ask.

noNameYet.orig: You haven't told me your name yet. Say "my name is ...".

recallMissing.orig: You haven't told me your {what} yet. Say "remember my {what} is ...".

recallNothing.orig: I don't have anything saved about you yet.

recallHeader.note: A list follows on the next lines, so end with a colon.

forgotNothing.orig: I didn't have anything saved about that.

pcNotPaired.orig: I'm not connected to your PC. Turn on PC Sync in Settings and pair with Nimbus first.

pcAppNotPaired.orig: I can only {action} apps on your PC once PC Sync is paired with Nimbus.

pcAppDone.note: {action} is a bare verb like 'open' or 'close'; keep it as a verb, e.g. 'I asked your PC to {action} {app}.'

pcAppOnIPad.orig: On iPad, apps can't {action} other apps. You can swipe up from the bottom to switch or close apps. If you pair me with Nimbus, say "{action} {app} on my PC".

pcStatusOff.orig: PC Sync is off, so I can't see your PC. You can turn it on in Settings.

tellMoreWhat.orig: More about what? Ask me something first.

tellMoreFail.orig: I couldn't find more about {topic} right now.

correctionSaved.orig: Thanks for fixing that. I'll say "{fix}" next time.

correctionAsk.orig: Oops. What should I have said?

taught.orig: Learned it! When you ask "{question}", I'll say "{answer}".

taughtAnswer.orig: Got it. Next time you ask "{question}", I'll say: {answer}

reminderSaved.orig: I'll remind you to {task}{when}. It's in the Nimbus list in Reminders.
reminderSaved.note: {when} is ' tomorrow at 5 PM' (leading space) or empty. Keep that it's in the Nimbus list in Reminders.

reminderSet.note: {when} is ' tomorrow at 5 PM' with a leading space, so write {task}{when} with no space between

reminderWhen.orig: When should I remind you? Try "remind me to {task} at 5pm".

calendarWhen.orig: When is it? Try "add soccer practice to my calendar tomorrow at 4pm".

calendarAddAsk.orig: Want me to add "{title}" {when} to your Nimbus calendar?
calendarAddAsk.note: {when} like 'tomorrow at 4 PM'. Must stay a yes/no question.

eventNotFound.orig: I couldn't find an event called "{what}".

eventFound.note: {change} like 'move it to Friday at 3 PM' or 'rename it to "Practice"'. Must stay a yes/no question.

deleteNotFound.orig: I couldn't find "{what}" on your calendar.

nothingComingUp.orig: Nothing coming up in the next 30 days.

calendarFree.orig: Nothing on your calendar {label}. You're free!

calendarList.note: {count} like '3 things'; {list} like 'Soccer at 4 PM, Dinner at 6 PM, plus 2 more'

guess.note: Said before a best-guess answer, so it's one short sentence.

dontKnow.orig: I don't know that one yet. You can teach me by saying "the answer to {question} is ...", or I can search the web.
dontKnow.note: Keep the teach-me example with {question} in quotes.

clarify.note: Asked when two answers fit. Must stay an either/or question.

followUpLost.orig: What are we talking about? Ask me the whole question and I'll answer it.
followUpLost.note: Said when someone asks 'what about it' with nothing before it.

summon.note: Said when someone just says Ace's name. {who} is ', Storm' or empty.

modelMissing.orig: LFM3 Omni isn't on this iPad yet, so Normal Ace answered. You can download it in Settings.
modelMissing.note: Said once, after Normal Ace answers, when LFM3 Omni is picked as the brain but not downloaded. Must mention LFM3 Omni and Settings.

homeOn.note: Said after turning a light, plug, switch or fan on in Apple Home. Short.

homeOff.note: Said after turning a home device off. Short.

homeLevel.note: Brightness was set. {level} is a number, keep the % sign right after {level}.

homeTemp.note: Thermostat target was set. {temp} already has its unit, like 70°F.

homeStatus.note: Reports a device's state. {state} is a phrase like 'on', 'off', 'at 40%' or 'set to 70°F'. Use it after 'is'.

homeList.note: Lead-in before a list of devices. {count} is like '6 devices'. Ends with a colon.

homeScene.note: An Apple Home scene (like Good Night) was run.

vacuumStart.note: Robot vacuum was told to start cleaning.

vacuumRoom.orig: Starting {device}. Apple Home can't pick rooms, so pick the {room} in the MOVA app if it cleans the whole house.
vacuumRoom.note: Vacuum started but Apple Home can't choose one room. Mention the MOVA app and {room}.

vacuumDock.note: Vacuum is going back to charge.

vacuumMissing.orig: I can't find a vacuum in Apple Home. In the MOVA app, add it to Apple Home with Matter, then ask me again.
vacuumMissing.note: No vacuum in Apple Home. Must mention the MOVA app, Apple Home and Matter.

homeNotFound.orig: I couldn't find {device} in Apple Home.
homeNotFound.note: No accessory matched. Can suggest checking the name in the Home app.

homeNoAccess.orig: I need Home access first. Turn it on in the Settings app, under Ace.
homeNoAccess.note: Home permission was denied. Must say where: the Settings app, under Ace.

homeNoHome.orig: There's no home in Apple Home yet. Set one up in the Home app first.
homeNoHome.note: No HomeKit home exists. Mention the Home app.

homeFailed.orig: {device} didn't respond. Check it's powered and connected in the Home app.

homeSafety.orig: For safety, use the Home app for locks, garage doors and alarms.
homeSafety.note: Ace won't control locks, garage doors or security systems.

homeConfirm.note: Asks before acting when Ace isn't sure which device was meant. Must be a yes or no question. {action} is a verb phrase like 'turn on'.

homeCancelled.note: User said no to a home action.

homeCantDo.note: The device doesn't support that command through Apple Home. {action} is a verb like 'pause'.
